Note
Nobody has walked these steps in LN yet. Follow them as written, and expect a screen or a label to differ. Walk it to say, at each step, whether it matched.

Walk itone step at a time · 6 steps

Steps

Why LN works this way. MRP nets the demand against stock and generates a planned production order for the pairs, then, through the BOM, planned purchase orders for the rods the pairs need. The arithmetic in the pegging tree is the test that it did so correctly.

StepActionYou should see
3.1Open Generate Order Planning (Item) cprrp1220m000 for BAM-CHOP-PAIRScenario ACT and Plan Item are set
3.2Select Include Child ItemsThe run will plan the rods and sleeves too
3.3Run the generationThe run completes
3.4Open Item Order Plan cprrp0520m000 for BAM-CHOP-PAIR and read the planned supply rowWrite downplanned production orderSupply equals ordered quantity minus on-hand
3.5Open Planned Orders cprrp1100m000 at Planning➔Order Planning➔Planned Orders, for the items' planning cluster and siteWrite downplanned purchase ordersevery row at Order Status Planned
3.6Select the planned production order and run Pegging - UpstreamWrite downpegging arithmetic checkeach level's children sum to its requirement

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
The run plans the pair but not a componentThe component has no planning data of its own. Step 1.4 (Preflight) — MRP skips it silently
A component has plan data and still produces nothingIt may be correctly absent — planning proposes supply only for what stock does not cover. Read its own Item Order Plan and on-hand
The pegging tree is emptyPegging relations were not generated, or the demand is beyond the Pegging Horizon in Planning Parameters cprpd0100m000

Plan to shipment
Run MRP

  1. Open Generate Order Planning (Item) for BAM-CHOP-PAIR

    You should see

    Scenario ACT and Plan Item are set

  2. Select Include Child Items

    You should see

    The run will plan the rods and sleeves too

  3. Run the generation

    You should see

    The run completes

  4. Open Item Order Plan for BAM-CHOP-PAIR and read the planned supply row

    You should see

    planned production order — Supply equals ordered quantity minus on-hand

  5. Open Planned Orders, for the items' planning cluster and site

    Planning➔Order Planning➔Planned Orders

    You should see

    planned purchase orders — every row at Order Status Planned

  6. Select the planned production order and run Pegging - Upstream

    You should see

    pegging arithmetic check — each level's children sum to its requirement

Nobody has confirmed this step in LN yet.

    • The run plans the pair but not a component

      The component has no planning data of its own. Step 4 of Preflight — MRP skips it silently

    • A component has plan data and still produces nothing

      It may be correctly absent — planning proposes supply only for what stock does not cover. Read its own Item Order Plan and on-hand

    • The pegging tree is empty

      Pegging relations were not generated, or the demand is beyond the Pegging Horizon in Planning Parameters cprpd0100m000

  • MRP nets the demand against stock and generates a planned production order for the pairs, then, through the BOM, planned purchase orders for the rods the pairs need. The arithmetic in the pegging tree is the test that it did so correctly.
